notes.title: English support, New system and new achievements
notes.content:
Thank you to all the users who are reading this article. Thank you so much for your frequent comments and feedbacks. We have made several improvements so that everyone can enjoy "Tales in the TAXI" even more.

[b]Updated contents[/b]
[list]
[*] English interface and English subtitles are officially supported.
[*] Added a flowchart system that allows you to move to any chapter you've played in the past.
[*] Added the achievements for each ending.
[*] Added a volume adjustment slider.
[*] Fixed other bugs.
[/list]

If you have any comments or problems, please contact Steam community or manpuku.entertainment@gmail.com . Thank you for your cooperation.
